Helen Browne
Director of AXA representing the employee shareholders
Expertise and experience
Helen Browne is a dual‑qualified lawyer. She graduated in law from the University of Kent in Canterbury (United 
Kingdom) (English & French Law), and the University of Grenoble (France). She is a Solicitor of the Senior Courts 
of England and Wales and was admitted to the Paris Bar in 1994. She joined Linklaters in 1987, working in 
London, Brussels and Paris and then joined the Legal Department of AXA Group in 2001 as Head of Finance 
before taking on the role of Head of M&A in 2009 and AXA Group Deputy General Counsel in 2014. She was 
appointed AXA Group General Counsel in 2016. Since June 2020, Helen Browne has been the employee 
shareholder representative to the AXA Board of Directors and since March 25, 2021, a member of the AXA 
Management Committee.

Bettina Cramm
Director of AXA representing the employees
Member of the AXA Compensation, Governance & Sustainability Committee
Expertise and experience
Bettina Cramm graduated as Medical Educator from the Martin‑Luther University (Halle/Saale – Germany). She 
started her career in 1984 as a Medical Technical Assistant at the German Klinik of Diagnostik of Wiesbaden 
(Germany). In 1991, she joined German‑Civil‑Servants‑Insurance (DBV), known today as AXA Konzern AG. From 
1991 to 1994, she was Power Clerk General Private Health Insurance at DBV and from 1994 to 2002, Operational 
Paramedic at DBV‑Winterthur Wiesbaden. From 2002 to 2007, Bettina Cramm was a Healthcare Consultant at 
DBV‑Winterthur. In 1995, she joined the Works Council at DBV‑Winterthur and was a member of the Supervisory 
Board of DBV‑Winterthur Health Insurance (2006‑2008), and member of the Supervisory Board of DBV 
Vermittlungsgesellschaft für Versicherungen und Vermögensbildung mbH (2007‑2008). From 2008 to 2013, and 
since her appointment as a director in 2018, she is responsible for prevention and health promotion in the 
company medical department at AXA Konzern AG. From 2013 to June 2018, Bettina Cramm held various 
functions as member of the Works Council, Central Works Council, European Works Council and their 
commissions and as member of the Supervisory Boards of AXA entities in Germany. From May 2017 to April 2022, 
she was a member of the Supervisory Board of AXA Konzern AG. In June 2018, Bettina Cramm was appointed 
director representing the employees on AXA's Board of Directors.
